notes: Strong forestry residue + large soybean straw base. Central India logistics hub (Bhopal, Indore). Large manure pool from extensive livestock.

name: Maharashtra

ag_residues_odt_mt.source: NPMCR 2014: Maharashtra gross ~46 Mt (3rd highest nationally); NPMCR burning fraction ~10.96 Mt; Hiloidhari et al. 2014; gross ~55 Mt (sugarcane+cotton+soybean+rice+jowar+wheat); 30% recoverable = ~22 Mt odt
ag_residues_odt_mt.notes: Major crops: sugarcane (Pune+Nashik belts — largest sugarcane state), cotton, soybean, rice (Konkan), jowar. Sugarcane tops/trash and bagasse are the dominant BiCRS feedstocks. Cotton stalk (woody) is significant.

forestry_residues_odt_mt.source: calc: ISFR 2021 Maharashtra forest ~50,700 km² (16.5% of state); Vidarbha region; some teak production; residue factor 0.25 t/ha on 12% accessible
forestry_residues_odt_mt.notes: 5th by forest area nationally

msw_total_mt.source: PMC9202976 Table 4: Maharashtra ~26,820 TPD (2015, highest of all states); scaled ×1.15 to 2020 = ~30,843 TPD; ×365÷1e6 = ~11.2 Mt/yr; Mumbai alone ~9,000 TPD
msw_total_mt.notes: LARGEST MSW-generating state. Mumbai is India's biggest single-city waste generator. Pune, Nagpur, Thane also major.

msw_biogenic_frac.source: World Bank What a Waste 2.0 (2018); Mumbai/Pune composition surveys ~55-58%

msw_treatment.source: CPCB SWM 2020-21; Maharashtra has WtE plants (Deonar WtE planned/operational); top-state for installed STP capacity

animal_manure_odt_mt.source: Frontiers in Agronomy 2025 (doi:10.3389/fagro.2025.1689121): Maharashtra total animal waste 42.7 Mt wet wt; × 0.20 DM fraction
animal_manure_odt_mt.notes: ~42.7 Mt wet → ~8.5 Mt odt. Mixed cattle+buffalo+goat.

human_wwtp_odt_mt.source: calc: ~127M pop × 45% urban × 55% STP coverage; Maharashtra top-1 state for installed STP capacity ~8,000 MLD (CPCB STP 2021); Mumbai MCGM has large STP network
human_wwtp_odt_mt.notes: Mumbai has India's largest STP network by capacity

nutrient_status_source: FAO; ~115 kg/ha NPK; moderate fertilizer use; sugarcane intensive but irrigation-dependent
notes: Sugarcane belt (Pune+Nashik+Aurangabad) is highly concentrated feedstock — sugar mills already processing bagasse. Prime BiCRS location. Mumbai MSW scale is unmatched nationally.

name: Manipur

ag_residues_odt_mt.source: calc: ~0.3 Mha cultivated; rice dominant (valley + jhum hill rice); RPR 1.3 × ~0.5 Mt rice production × 30% recoverable = ~0.25 Mt odt
ag_residues_odt_mt.notes: Imphal valley wet rice; hill jhum cultivation. Very limited surplus.

forestry_residues_odt_mt.source: calc: ISFR 2021 Manipur forest ~17,200 km² (77% of state); but losing cover rapidly (1.48% loss 2019-21); limited commercial access; residue factor 0.2 t/ha on 8% accessible
forestry_residues_odt_mt.notes: High forest cover but rapid degradation. Bamboo abundant.

msw_total_mt.source: PMC9202976: Manipur ~176 TPD (2015 — lowest state); scaled ×1.15 to 2020; ×365÷1e6
msw_total_mt.notes: Lowest per-capita MSW in India (220 g/day)

msw_biogenic_frac.source: World Bank What a Waste 2.0 (2018); high organic fraction in NE tribal diet

animal_manure_odt_mt.source: calc: 20th Livestock Census 2019 Manipur ~700,000 cattle+pig+goat; ×10 kg/head eq/day ×0.20 DM ×365 ÷1e6
animal_manure_odt_mt.notes: Significant pig farming (NE India)

human_wwtp_odt_mt.source: calc: ~3.2M pop × 33% urban × minimal STP; CPCB: no STP in Manipur (2021)

nutrient_status_source: FAO/state; shifting cultivation system, low external fertilizer input
notes: Small feedstock base. Conflict-affected state limits infrastructure. Bamboo is best BiCRS opportunity.

name: Meghalaya

ag_residues_odt_mt.source: calc: ~0.3 Mha cultivated; rice+potato+ginger+areca nut; RPR × small production × 30%
ag_residues_odt_mt.notes: Meghalaya 'wettest place on earth' region; limited intensive cropping

forestry_residues_odt_mt.source: calc: ISFR 2021 Meghalaya forest ~17,600 km² (79% of state); community-managed forests; limited commercial logging; residue factor 0.2 t/ha on 10% accessible
forestry_residues_odt_mt.notes: Community forest (bhoi) system limits commercial extraction; significant bamboo

msw_total_mt.source: calc: ~3.5M pop × 0.28 kg/capita/day × 365 ÷ 1e6; Shillong dominant

msw_biogenic_frac.source: World Bank What a Waste 2.0 (2018); NE India high organic

msw_treatment.source: CPCB SWM 2020-21; limited MSW infrastructure

animal_manure_odt_mt.source: calc: 20th Livestock Census 2019 Meghalaya ~700,000 cattle+pig+goat; ×10 kg/head eq/day ×0.20 DM ×365 ÷1e6

human_wwtp_odt_mt.source: calc: ~3.5M pop × 25% urban × no STP; CPCB: no STP in Meghalaya

nutrient_status_source: FAO; very low external fertilizer; acidic soils; community farming
notes: Small feedstock. Community forest governance complicates commercial residue extraction.

name: Mizoram

animal_manure_odt_mt.notes: Pig farming significant in Mizoram

human_wwtp_odt_mt.source: calc: ~1.25M pop × minimal STP; CPCB: no STP in Mizoram

name: Nagaland

ag_residues_odt_mt.source: calc: ~0.2 Mha cultivated; jhum rice+maize+millet; RPR ×low production ×30%

forestry_residues_odt_mt.notes: Rapid deforestation due to jhum and infrastructure. Bamboo residue.

msw_total_mt.source: calc: ~2.2M pop × 0.30 kg/capita/day × 365 ÷ 1e6; Kohima, Dimapur

msw_biogenic_frac.source: World Bank What a Waste 2.0 (2018)

msw_treatment.source: CPCB SWM 2020-21; CPCB: no STP in Nagaland

animal_manure_odt_mt.notes: Mithun semi-wild; pig farming significant

human_wwtp_odt_mt.source: calc: ~2.2M pop × minimal STP; CPCB: no STP in Nagaland

name: Punjab

ag_residues_odt_mt.source: NPMCR 2014: Punjab gross 51 Mt (2nd highest nationally); Punjab paddy area ~3 Mha × 5 t/ha paddy prod × RPR 1.5 = ~22.5 Mt rice straw + wheat 3.5 Mha × 3 t/ha × RPR 1.2 = ~12.6 Mt wheat straw; gross ~35 Mt; 30% recoverable surplus = ~14 Mt. IndiaDataInsights: Punjab 19-20 Mt paddy straw + 20 Mt wheat straw gross (2009 data); 30% = ~16-18 Mt recoverable. Central estimate 21 Mt accounting for productivity growth 2009-2020.
ag_residues_odt_mt.notes: STUBBLE-BURNING HOTSPOT (PRIMARY): Punjab burns 15-20 Mt paddy straw annually (Oct-Nov, 2-3 weeks) — #1 BiCRS feedstock opportunity in India. Rice straw currently treated as agricultural waste with near-zero economic value. Wheat straw has more fodder/industrial use. Green Revolution belt — monoculture rice-wheat rotation depleting groundwater and soil health.

forestry_residues_odt_mt.source: calc: ISFR 2021 Punjab forest ~3,600 km² (7.2% of state); mostly Shivalik foothills plantation; minimal commercial forestry
forestry_residues_odt_mt.notes: Very limited forest cover — agricultural state

msw_total_mt.source: calc: ~30M pop × 0.38 kg/capita/day (Punjab high per-capita, prosperous state) × 365 ÷ 1e6; Ludhiana, Amritsar, Jalandhar major generators
msw_total_mt.notes: Punjab top-10 state for installed STP capacity

msw_biogenic_frac.source: World Bank What a Waste 2.0 (2018); relatively higher income, lower organic fraction

msw_treatment.source: CPCB SWM 2020-21; Punjab top-10 state for STP capacity installed

animal_manure_odt_mt.source: calc: 20th Livestock Census 2019 Punjab ~11M cattle+buffalo (dairy belt); ×12 kg/day ×0.20 DM ×365 ÷1e6 = ~9.6 Mt wet ×0.20 = ~3.5 Mt odt; mostly stall-fed dairy cooperative system
animal_manure_odt_mt.notes: High-quality stall-fed manure from dairy belt. Biogas from dairy manure is well-established.

human_wwtp_odt_mt.source: calc: ~30M pop × 37% urban × 60% STP coverage; Punjab top-10 STP installed ~800 MLD (CPCB STP 2021)

nutrient_status_source: FAO fertilizer statistics 2019-20; Punjab ~210 kg/ha NPK — Green Revolution epicenter; highest historical fertilizer use; soil health cards show P+K saturation
notes: STUBBLE-BURNING FLAG: 15-20 Mt paddy straw burned annually — highest single-state BiCRS opportunity in India. EXCESS NUTRIENTS: 210 kg/ha NPK, favoring burial/soil-amendment-neutral pathways. Dense road network and flat terrain make feedstock aggregation feasible.

name: Rajasthan

ag_residues_odt_mt.source: calc: ~20 Mha net sown area (largest cultivated area after MP); wheat+bajra (pearl millet)+mustard+jowar+maize; RPR × ~30 Mt gross residue (bajra RPR 1.2, wheat RPR 1.2, mustard RPR 1.5) × 30% recoverable = ~11.5 Mt odt. Corroborated: NPMCR ~4.27 Mt burning fraction; total gross much larger.
ag_residues_odt_mt.notes: Bajra (pearl millet) straw is major residue — low moisture, suitable for biochar. Mustard stalk woody residue. Large state by area but semi-arid limits productivity.

forestry_residues_odt_mt.source: calc: ISFR 2021 Rajasthan forest ~16,600 km² (4.9% of state — mostly Aravallis and Shekhawati scrub); minimal commercial forestry; Khejri (Prosopis) agroforestry residue some value
forestry_residues_odt_mt.notes: Arid state; limited forest biomass

msw_total_mt.source: calc: ~79M pop × 0.33 kg/capita/day × 365 ÷ 1e6; Jaipur, Jodhpur, Kota, Udaipur major generators; Rajasthan top-10 STP state

msw_biogenic_frac.source: World Bank What a Waste 2.0 (2018)

msw_treatment.source: CPCB SWM 2020-21; Rajasthan top-10 state for STP installed capacity

animal_manure_odt_mt.source: Frontiers in Agronomy 2025 (doi:10.3389/fagro.2025.1689121): Rajasthan total animal waste 61.4 Mt wet wt; × 0.20 DM fraction
animal_manure_odt_mt.notes: ~61.4 Mt wet → ~12.3 Mt odt. 2nd-highest manure state nationally. Huge camel+cattle+sheep+goat population. Nomadic pastoralism limits collection.

human_wwtp_odt_mt.source: calc: ~79M pop × 25% urban × 40% STP coverage; Rajasthan top-10 installed STP capacity ~800 MLD (CPCB STP 2021)

nutrient_status_source: FAO; ~95 kg/ha NPK; semi-arid dryland farming, lower fertilizer use than irrigated states
notes: Manure dominant feedstock by mass due to massive pastoral livestock. Bajra straw (low moisture) is excellent biochar feedstock. Logistical challenges of sparse rural population.

forestry_residues_odt_mt.notes: Protected Himalayan biodiversity; very limited extraction

msw_total_mt.source: calc: ~0.7M pop × 0.40 kg/capita/day × 365 ÷ 1e6; Gangtok dominant
msw_total_mt.notes: Small state; tourism adds seasonal waste load

msw_biogenic_frac.source: World Bank What a Waste 2.0 (2018)

msw_treatment.source: CPCB SWM 2020-21; Sikkim reported 100% collection (CPCB 2020-21)

animal_manure_odt_mt.notes: Yak farming at altitude

human_wwtp_odt_mt.source: calc: ~0.7M pop × 25% urban × partial STP; Gangtok has small STP

name: Tamil Nadu

msw_total_mt.notes: Chennai alone ~4,500 TPD. TN is 2nd highest MSW state (PMC data). Highly urbanized (48%).

name: Telangana

forestry_residues_odt_mt.source: calc: ISFR 2021 Telangana forest ~27,200 km² (24% of state); Nagarjunasagar-Srisailam TR; limited commercial logging; teak/bamboo
forestry_residues_odt_mt.notes: Tiger Reserves restrict commercial extraction

msw_total_mt.source: calc: ~40M pop × 0.38 kg/capita/day (Hyderabad high per-capita ~0.6 kg/day for city) × 365 ÷ 1e6; Hyderabad ~4,200 TPD (GHMC); remaining state adds ~600 TPD
msw_total_mt.notes: Hyderabad is single dominant waste generator; GHMC has advanced MSW infrastructure

msw_biogenic_frac.source: World Bank What a Waste 2.0 (2018); Hyderabad composition surveys

msw_treatment.source: CPCB SWM 2020-21; Telangana reported 100% collection; Hyderabad has WtE plant

animal_manure_odt_mt.source: Frontiers in Agronomy 2025 (doi:10.3389/fagro.2025.1689121): Telangana total animal waste 23.0 Mt wet wt; × 0.20 DM fraction
animal_manure_odt_mt.notes: ~23.0 Mt wet → ~4.6 Mt odt

human_wwtp_odt_mt.source: calc: ~40M pop × 46% urban × 50% STP coverage; Hyderabad HMWSSB has large STP network; CPCB STP 2021 Telangana ~1,200 MLD

nutrient_status_source: Telangana among top-3 states in fertilizer use per ha (>200 kg/ha NPK, Dept Agriculture 2019-20); intensive irrigated rice cultivation under Kaleshwaram project
notes: Hyderabad is high-value MSW node. Cotton stalk+rice straw concentrated in Telangana ag belt. EXCESS NUTRIENTS — intensive irrigated rice.

name: Tripura

ag_residues_odt_mt.source: calc: ~0.35 Mha cultivated; rice (Boro+Aman+Aus)+rubber+pineapple; RPR × ~0.6 Mt rice prod × 1.4 = 0.84 Mt rice straw; 30% recoverable; rubber wood at replanting additional
ag_residues_odt_mt.notes: 3rd-largest natural rubber producer in India. Rubber wood is significant lignocellulosic feedstock.

forestry_residues_odt_mt.source: calc: ISFR 2021 Tripura forest ~7,726 km² (73% of state); rubber plantations (private) substantial; TFDC operations; residue factor 0.2 t/ha on 10% accessible
forestry_residues_odt_mt.notes: Rubber plantation wood at replanting is economically significant feedstock

msw_total_mt.source: calc: ~4.2M pop × 0.35 kg/capita/day × 365 ÷ 1e6; Agartala dominant city

msw_biogenic_frac.source: World Bank What a Waste 2.0 (2018)

msw_treatment.source: CPCB SWM 2020-21

animal_manure_odt_mt.source: calc: 20th Livestock Census 2019 Tripura ~1M cattle+goat+pig; ×10 ×0.20 ×365 ÷1e6

human_wwtp_odt_mt.source: calc: ~4.2M pop × 27% urban × minimal STP; Agartala small STP

nutrient_status_source: FAO; mixed tribal farming; ~70 kg/ha NPK; rubber plantations low nutrient need
notes: Rubber wood feedstock is underappreciated. 3rd-largest rubber state.

name: Uttar Pradesh

ag_residues_odt_mt.source: NPMCR 2014: UP gross 60 Mt (highest nationally); Assessment of bioenergy 2021: UP gross 116.69 Mt, surplus 41.76 Mt; multiple studies corroborate 40-45 Mt surplus. 30% recoverable from 100 Mt gross = 40 Mt odt. Major crops: sugarcane (~largest producer nationally), wheat, rice, maize, potato.
ag_residues_odt_mt.notes: LARGEST RESIDUE STATE by surplus: sugarcane trash+tops, wheat straw (Kharif+Rabi), rice straw. Sugarcane: UP produces ~200 Mt cane/yr × tops/trash residue 15% = ~30 Mt gross; rice+wheat add ~70 Mt more. STUBBLE-BURNING: UP in top 4 burning states (>30% burned per NPMCR).

forestry_residues_odt_mt.source: calc: ISFR 2021 UP forest ~14,800 km² (6.1% of state); Terai belt and Vindhyan scrub; some Sal timber; residue factor 0.2 t/ha on 15% accessible
forestry_residues_odt_mt.notes: Low forest cover for huge state; mostly agricultural plain

msw_total_mt.source: PMC9202976 Table 4: UP ~19,180 TPD (2015 data, 2nd highest after Maharashtra); scaled ×1.15 = ~22,000 TPD 2020; ×365÷1e6 = ~8.0 Mt; adjusted up for massive pop growth to 9.0 Mt; pop ~241M × 0.27 kg/capita/day crosscheck = 9.4 Mt
msw_total_mt.notes: Largest population state. Lucknow, Kanpur, Agra, Varanasi, Ghaziabad, Noida major generators. Kanpur is among most polluted cities in India.

msw_biogenic_frac.source: World Bank What a Waste 2.0 (2018); lower-income large state, high organic fraction

msw_treatment.source: CPCB SWM 2020-21; UP has multiple small WtE plants; top-5 state for installed STP capacity

animal_manure_odt_mt.source: Frontiers in Agronomy 2025 (doi:10.3389/fagro.2025.1689121): UP total animal waste 112.4 Mt wet wt; × 0.20 DM fraction
animal_manure_odt_mt.notes: ~112.4 Mt wet → ~22.5 Mt odt. BY FAR the largest manure state — largest cattle+buffalo population nationally. India's dairy heartland (Mathura, Agra, Meerut, Bareilly belts).

human_wwtp_odt_mt.source: calc: ~241M pop × 22% urban × 40% STP coverage; UP top-5 installed STP capacity ~3,000 MLD (CPCB STP 2021); Lucknow, Kanpur STPs significant

nutrient_status_source: FAO fertilizer statistics; western UP (Meerut, Agra, Aligarh) ~180 kg/ha — Green Revolution belt; eastern UP lower ~100 kg/ha; average classified excess for western zone
notes: HIGHEST TOTAL FEEDSTOCK STATE in India. Sugarcane belt in western UP is most concentrated biomass node. STUBBLE-BURNING: western UP burns heavily. EXCESS NUTRIENTS in western Green Revolution belt. Co-location of sugar mills (bagasse) + crop residue makes BiCRS hub economically attractive.

name: Uttarakhand

ag_residues_odt_mt.source: calc: ~0.8 Mha cultivated (Terai belt + mountain terraces); wheat+rice+sugarcane in Terai; RPR × production × 30% recoverable; mountain terraces very low yield
ag_residues_odt_mt.notes: Terai plains (Haridwar, Udham Singh Nagar) have concentrated sugarcane+rice residue; hill districts minimal

forestry_residues_odt_mt.source: calc: ISFR 2021 Uttarakhand forest ~38,200 km² (71% of state); Kumaon/Garhwal mixed forest; FRI Dehradun operations; chir pine, oak, deodar; residue factor 0.3 t/ha on 15% accessible
forestry_residues_odt_mt.notes: FRI (Forest Research Institute) Dehradun — good data availability. Chir pine is abundant but resinous — challenges for combustion, good for biochar.

msw_total_mt.source: calc: ~11M pop × 0.36 kg/capita/day × 365 ÷ 1e6; Dehradun, Haridwar, Roorkee dominant; Uttarakhand reported 100% collection (CPCB 2020-21)
msw_total_mt.notes: Pilgrimage cities (Haridwar, Rishikesh) seasonal waste surge

msw_biogenic_frac.source: World Bank What a Waste 2.0 (2018)

msw_treatment.source: CPCB SWM 2020-21; Uttarakhand reported 100% collection

animal_manure_odt_mt.source: calc: 20th Livestock Census 2019 Uttarakhand ~3.5M cattle+buffalo; mostly hill cattle (small); ×9 kg/day ×0.20 DM ×365 ÷1e6
animal_manure_odt_mt.notes: Hill-transhumance cattle; lower manure collectability

human_wwtp_odt_mt.source: calc: ~11M pop × 31% urban × 30% STP coverage; Haridwar, Dehradun have STPs; Namami Gange program improving Ganga-corridor STPs

nutrient_status_source: FAO; mountain state ~65 kg/ha NPK; Terai belt higher but classified as distinct zone
notes: Terai ag residue and mountain forest residue split. Chir pine pine-needle collection for energy has existing programs. Ganga-corridor STP improvement under Namami Gange.

name: West Bengal

ag_residues_odt_mt.source: calc: ~6.0 Mha net sown area; rice (3 crops: Aus+Aman+Boro, highest rice intensity nationally) + jute + potato + mustard + wheat; gross ~35 Mt; 30% recoverable = ~14 Mt odt. Corroborated: PMC9202976 WB among top-5 residue states; Hiloidhari et al. 2014 confirms significant surplus.
ag_residues_odt_mt.notes: Highest rice cropping intensity in India (2.4 crops/yr on rice land). Jute stalk (retting residue) significant. Aman rice straw burned or rotted in field before Rabi season.

forestry_residues_odt_mt.source: calc: ISFR 2021 WB forest ~16,800 km² (19% of state); Sundarbans mangroves (protected) + Darjeeling/Terai; limited logging; some tea-garden pruning residue; residue factor 0.2 t/ha on 15% accessible
forestry_residues_odt_mt.notes: Sundarbans strictly protected. Darjeeling tea garden wood pruning is minor but collectible.

msw_total_mt.source: PMC9202976 Table 4: WB ~8,674 TPD (2015 data); scaled ×1.15 = ~9,975 TPD 2020; ×365÷1e6 = ~3.6 Mt; adjusted up for pop growth to 4.2 Mt; Kolkata alone ~3,500-4,000 TPD
msw_total_mt.notes: Kolkata (Dhapa landfill) is a massive waste sink. WB 4th-most-populous state.

msw_biogenic_frac.source: World Bank What a Waste 2.0 (2018); Kolkata composition surveys ~60%

msw_treatment.source: CPCB SWM 2020-21; Kolkata Dhapa landfill is notoriously overloaded

animal_manure_odt_mt.source: Frontiers in Agronomy 2025 (doi:10.3389/fagro.2025.1689121): West Bengal total animal waste 41.4 Mt wet wt; × 0.20 DM fraction
animal_manure_odt_mt.notes: ~41.4 Mt wet → ~8.3 Mt odt. Dense smallholder dairy+poultry.

human_wwtp_odt_mt.source: calc: ~99M pop × 32% urban × 40% STP coverage; Kolkata KMC STP network; CPCB STP 2021 WB ~1,000 MLD installed

nutrient_status_source: FAO; ~140 kg/ha NPK; intensive multi-crop rice cultivation requires moderate fertilizer; slightly above national average
notes: Triple-crop rice makes WB a major but diffuse residue state. Kolkata is the key MSW BiCRS node. Jute stalk is an underutilized lignocellulosic feedstock.

name: Anhui

ag_residues_odt_mt.source: calc: NBS 2022 crop output (Anhui ~30 Mt grain, mainly wheat+rice); Liu et al. 2013 Renew.Sust.Energ.Rev. residue-to-product ratios; 30% recoverable fraction (Slade et al. 2014)
ag_residues_odt_mt.notes: Anhui is 4th-5th largest grain province; primary crops wheat (~13 Mt), rice (~15 Mt), maize (~5 Mt). Gross field residue ~55 Mt × 40% = 22 Mt odt recoverable

forestry_residues_odt_mt.source: Guo et al. 2023 Scientific Data (China biomass dataset); Chen et al. 2020 Resour.Conserv.Recycl. forestry residue by province
forestry_residues_odt_mt.notes: Moderate forest cover in Dabie Shan; mainly economic forest and logging residue

msw_total_mt.source: calc: China national MSW 244 Mt (China Statistical Yearbook 2022); scaled by Anhui population 61.3 M / 1,412 M × 244 Mt; adjusted for lower urban income vs national avg
msw_total_mt.notes: Urban population ~55%; per-capita generation ~0.48 kg/d, slightly below national avg

msw_biogenic_frac.source: Dong et al. 2019 Environ.Sci.Technol.; China avg food waste share ~45-55% of MSW; biogenic (food+paper+wood) ~55%
msw_biogenic_frac.notes: Higher biogenic fraction vs coastal provinces due to larger food-waste share

msw_treatment.source: China Statistical Yearbook on Environment 2022; national WtE now ~75% but inland provinces lag; Anhui ~65% incineration per provincial environmental reports

animal_manure_odt_mt.source: calc: China total livestock manure ~840 Mt total solids/yr (Ma et al. 2020 Sci.Total Environ.); Anhui ~1.4% share of national hog+poultry; adjusted by FAO livestock heads × excretion factors
animal_manure_odt_mt.notes: Moderate hog production; dry-matter basis at ~15-20% DM conversion

human_wwtp_odt_mt.source: calc: China 13.6 Mt DS sludge 2022 (Towards new era of sewage sludge management, ScienceDirect 2025); apportioned by population (Anhui 61.3 M / 1,412 M)
human_wwtp_odt_mt.notes: WWTP coverage expanding; sludge DS ~0.022 kg/person/day urban assumption

nutrient_status_source: FAO 2022 fertilizer use data; Anhui N application ~250 kg N/ha, above national threshold; Zhang et al. 2015 Nature excess nutrient regions
notes: Major wheat-rice double-cropping province. North China Plain transition zone; intensive N fertilizer use. Significant straw burning historically being phased out.

name: Beijing

ag_residues_odt_mt.source: calc: NBS 2022; Beijing grain output minimal (~0.3 Mt); mostly peri-urban horticulture; Liu et al. 2013 field residues Beijing ~1.26 Mt air-dry → 0.4 Mt recoverable odt
ag_residues_odt_mt.notes: Mostly urbanized; remaining farmland in Shunyi/Tongzhou districts

forestry_residues_odt_mt.source: Guo et al. 2023 Scientific Data; Beijing afforestation programs in Yanshan/Taihang foothills; mainly shrubland processing residue
forestry_residues_odt_mt.notes: Forest cover is largely protective/amenity; low commercial harvest

msw_total_mt.source: Beijing Municipal Bureau of Statistics 2022; Beijing MSW ~9-10 Mt/yr reported; national avg per capita ~0.42 Mt/yr scaled to 21.8 M pop gives ~9.2
msw_total_mt.notes: High urbanization (>85%); high per-capita generation ~1.1 kg/d

msw_biogenic_frac.source: Dong et al. 2019 Environ.Sci.Technol.; Beijing higher income → more packaging/plastics, lower biogenic share than national avg
msw_biogenic_frac.notes: Food waste still dominant but lower fraction than rural provinces

msw_treatment.source: Beijing solid waste management annual report 2022; Beijing leads in WtE deployment; mandatory waste sorting since 2020

animal_manure_odt_mt.source: calc: NBS livestock census; Beijing hog/poultry largely relocated from city core; peri-urban dairy/poultry; estimated from national manure 840 Mt × 0.06% share
animal_manure_odt_mt.notes: Most livestock operations moved outside municipal boundaries under environmental regulations

human_wwtp_odt_mt.source: calc: China 13.6 Mt DS sludge 2022 (ScienceDirect 2025); Beijing pop 21.8 M / 1,412 M × 13.6 Mt
human_wwtp_odt_mt.notes: High WWTP coverage (~95%); advanced treatment; sludge management well-documented

nutrient_status_source: Zhang et al. 2015 Nature; Beijing peri-urban agriculture uses high inputs but limited area; overall moderate given small ag footprint
notes: MSW-dominant megacity. Agriculture minimal. High WtE capacity. Sludge management increasingly prioritized under national policy.

name: Chongqing

ag_residues_odt_mt.source: calc: NBS 2022; Chongqing grain ~12 Mt (rice, maize); Liu et al. 2013 RPR; 30% recoverable. Mountainous terrain limits recovery
ag_residues_odt_mt.notes: Large municipality but rugged terrain reduces effective recovery; rice/maize dominant

forestry_residues_odt_mt.source: Guo et al. 2023 Scientific Data; Three Gorges area forest resources; Chen et al. 2020 forestry residue assessment SW China
forestry_residues_odt_mt.notes: Significant forest area along Yangtze; logging and processing residue

msw_total_mt.source: calc: Chongqing pop 32.1 M; urbanization ~72%; per-capita MSW ~0.73 kg/d → 8.5 Mt/yr; consistent with regional reports
msw_total_mt.notes: Megacity with large rural hinterland; effective MSW ~8-9 Mt from urban areas

msw_biogenic_frac.source: Dong et al. 2019; Chongqing food-heavy diet pattern; food waste dominant
msw_biogenic_frac.notes: Spicy/oil-rich food waste still largely biogenic

msw_treatment.source: China Statistical Yearbook on Environment 2022; Chongqing WtE capacity expansion per national targets

animal_manure_odt_mt.source: calc: Chongqing is major hog producer (~10.3% of national pigs per NBS); national manure 840 Mt total solids × ~1.2% share
animal_manure_odt_mt.notes: Dense hog farming in basin lowlands; Sichuan-Chongqing region collectively ~10% national pork output

human_wwtp_odt_mt.source: calc: Chongqing pop 32.1 M / 1,412 M × 13.6 Mt national DS sludge
human_wwtp_odt_mt.notes: WWTP coverage improving; major infrastructure investment post-Three Gorges

nutrient_status_source: Zhang et al. 2015 Nature excess nutrient map; SW China intensive horticulture + pig slurry over-application
notes: Hilly terrain limits biomass aggregation. High hog density. Mixed ag/forestry resource base. Yangtze River water quality concerns drive manure management policy.

name: Fujian

ag_residues_odt_mt.source: calc: NBS 2022; Fujian grain ~8 Mt (rice dominant); sugarcane minor; Liu et al. 2013 RPR; 30% recoverable
ag_residues_odt_mt.notes: Mainly rice-producing; mountainous interior limits flat-field residue; coastal horticulture contributes

forestry_residues_odt_mt.source: Chen et al. 2020 ScienceDirect forest residue by province; Guo et al. 2023: Fujian 26 Mt total forestry residue; Fujian accounts for ~10.2% of national forestry residue (Ma et al. 2020)
forestry_residues_odt_mt.notes: Fujian is China's top forestry province per capita; dense subtropical forests; eucalyptus/Chinese fir plantations; bamboo processing residue significant. 26 Mt gross → ~14 Mt recoverable

msw_total_mt.source: calc: Fujian pop 41.9 M; high urbanization (>67%); per-capita MSW ~0.62 kg/d coastal average; Eastern coastal provinces generate >47% of national MSW (Wu et al. 2021 Frontiers)
msw_total_mt.notes: Coastal industrial province; significant e-waste and packaging in MSW stream

msw_biogenic_frac.source: Dong et al. 2019; coastal higher-income reduces biogenic fraction; packaging increases
msw_biogenic_frac.notes: More plastic/packaging than inland; biogenic ~50%

msw_treatment.source: China Statistical Yearbook on Environment 2022; Fujian high WtE adoption consistent with eastern coastal pattern

animal_manure_odt_mt.source: calc: Fujian pig production ~3% national; poultry moderate; national manure 840 Mt × ~0.7% share
animal_manure_odt_mt.notes: Significant poultry; coastal aquaculture sludge not included here

human_wwtp_odt_mt.source: calc: Fujian pop 41.9 M / 1,412 M × 13.6 Mt national DS sludge
human_wwtp_odt_mt.notes: High WWTP investment in coastal cities (Fuzhou, Xiamen, Quanzhou)

nutrient_status_source: Zhang et al. 2015 Nature; Fujian has intensive horticulture but better practices than North China Plain
notes: Forestry residue is dominant biomass type. China's largest timber province. Subtropical forests support significant woody biomass supply chain.

name: Gansu

ag_residues_odt_mt.source: calc: NBS 2022; Gansu grain ~12 Mt (wheat, maize, potato); Liu et al. 2013 RPR; 30% recoverable; aridity limits biomass quality
ag_residues_odt_mt.notes: Loess Plateau; wheat/potato dominant; dry straw with good fuel properties but dispersed across large area

forestry_residues_odt_mt.source: Guo et al. 2023 Scientific Data; Gansu forest cover ~11%; limited commercial timber; Qilian Shan conifer forests
forestry_residues_odt_mt.notes: Semi-arid to arid; limited forest biomass; Gannan Tibetan Plateau area has some conifer resources

msw_total_mt.source: calc: Gansu pop 24.9 M; per-capita MSW lower than national avg (~0.46 kg/d); low urbanization (~49%)
msw_total_mt.notes: One of China's poorest provinces; lower per-capita waste generation; significant rural open dumping

msw_biogenic_frac.source: Dong et al. 2019; poor/rural areas generate more food waste biogenic fraction
msw_biogenic_frac.notes: High biogenic fraction consistent with lower-income rural areas

msw_treatment.source: China Statistical Yearbook on Environment 2022; western/inland provinces lag in WtE deployment

animal_manure_odt_mt.source: calc: Gansu significant sheep/cattle; NBS livestock census; national manure 840 Mt × ~0.8% share; corrected for ruminant DM fraction
animal_manure_odt_mt.notes: Sheep/cattle dominant (ruminant manure lower DM than hog); Gansu is significant livestock province

human_wwtp_odt_mt.source: calc: Gansu pop 24.9 M / 1,412 M × 13.6 Mt; adjusted downward for lower WWTP coverage (~60%)
human_wwtp_odt_mt.notes: WWTP coverage below national average; sludge management underdeveloped

nutrient_status_source: Zhang et al. 2015 Nature; Gansu nutrient-poor soils on Loess Plateau; fertilizer use below national average
notes: Water-scarce province; biomass dispersed over large area. Ag residues available but remote. Significant wind/solar energy competing pathway.

name: Guangdong

ag_residues_odt_mt.source: calc: NBS 2022; Guangdong grain ~17 Mt (rice dominant, 2 crops); sugarcane ~10 Mt; Liu et al. 2013 RPR rice 0.9, sugarcane tops 0.1; 30% recoverable
ag_residues_odt_mt.notes: Double-crop rice + sugarcane; but highly urbanized (>75%) reduces agricultural land base

forestry_residues_odt_mt.source: Guo et al. 2023 Scientific Data; Chen et al. 2020; subtropical plantation forests; eucalyptus pulp significant
forestry_residues_odt_mt.notes: Subtropical plantation forests but intensive harvest reduces residue availability; eucalyptus bark/chips significant

msw_total_mt.source: calc: Guangdong pop 127 M; highest MSW province; per-capita ~0.61 kg/d; Wu et al. 2021 Frontiers identifies Guangdong as top MSW generator; consistent with national 244 Mt share
msw_total_mt.notes: Most populous province; Pearl River Delta megacity cluster; highest total MSW volume in China

msw_biogenic_frac.source: Dong et al. 2019; higher income Pearl River Delta reduces biogenic fraction; more packaging
msw_biogenic_frac.notes: Biogenic ~50%; significant plastic/packaging from industrial economy

msw_treatment.source: Guangdong provincial environmental bureau reports 2022; among highest WtE utilization in China; major WtE capacity in Guangzhou/Shenzhen

animal_manure_odt_mt.source: calc: Guangdong pig production ~3.5% national; poultry largest in China; national manure 840 Mt × ~1.7% share
animal_manure_odt_mt.notes: Largest poultry production in China; pig manure management is environmental priority

human_wwtp_odt_mt.source: calc: Guangdong pop 127 M / 1,412 M × 13.6 Mt national DS sludge; high WWTP coverage (>90%)
human_wwtp_odt_mt.notes: Largest absolute sludge volume in China; advanced treatment in PRD cities

nutrient_status_source: Zhang et al. 2015 Nature; intensive vegetable/fruit production in PRD; nutrient loading from livestock in rural areas
notes: Most populous province; MSW + manure dominant by volume. High WtE capacity already deployed. Ag biomass secondary given urbanization.

name: Guangxi

ag_residues_odt_mt.source: calc: NBS 2022; Guangxi grain ~17 Mt; sugarcane ~70 Mt (60% of national output); Liu et al. 2013 RPR; sugarcane tops+leaves 0.15 × 70 Mt = 10.5 Mt; rice 0.9 × 8 Mt = 7.2 Mt; 30% recoverable
ag_residues_odt_mt.notes: Largest sugarcane province; bagasse handled at mills separately; field residue (tops/leaves) significant

forestry_residues_odt_mt.source: Guo et al. 2023 Scientific Data: Guangxi 50 Mt gross forestry residue, 2nd nationally; accounts for ~10.3% national total (Chen et al. 2020); Ma et al. 2020 forestry residue 17.88-32.66 Mt sustainable
forestry_residues_odt_mt.notes: China's largest plantation forest area; eucalyptus pulp industry generates huge processing residue; bamboo residue additional. 50 Mt gross → ~28 Mt recoverable odt

msw_total_mt.source: calc: Guangxi pop 50.5 M; urbanization ~55%; per-capita MSW ~0.57 kg/d; Wu et al. 2021
msw_total_mt.notes: Growing industrial base in coastal areas; Nanning-Guilin corridor

msw_biogenic_frac.source: Dong et al. 2019; semi-rural province with higher food waste fraction
msw_biogenic_frac.notes: Sugarcane and tropical food culture contributes high organic fraction

msw_treatment.source: China Statistical Yearbook on Environment 2022; Guangxi mid-tier WtE deployment

animal_manure_odt_mt.source: calc: Guangxi pig production ~4% national; national manure 840 Mt × ~1.2% share; buffalo (water buffalo) manure additional
animal_manure_odt_mt.notes: Water buffalo farming unique to Guangxi; significant cattle for sugarcane cultivation

human_wwtp_odt_mt.source: calc: Guangxi pop 50.5 M / 1,412 M × 13.6 Mt
human_wwtp_odt_mt.notes: WWTP coverage expanding but below coastal average

nutrient_status_source: Zhang et al. 2015 Nature; Guangxi karst soils variable; sugarcane fields moderately fertilized
notes: China's largest plantation forestry province and top sugarcane producer. Eucalyptus wood residue from pulp mills is a concentrated feedstock. Water-energy nexus in karst area.

name: Guizhou

ag_residues_odt_mt.source: calc: NBS 2022; Guizhou grain ~12 Mt (maize, rice, rapeseed); Liu et al. 2013 RPR; 30% recoverable; rugged terrain limits recovery
ag_residues_odt_mt.notes: Karst plateau; steep terrain limits mechanized collection. Rice + maize dominant. High variation in residue quality.

forestry_residues_odt_mt.source: Guo et al. 2023 Scientific Data; Guizhou 88 Mt energy crop potential (2nd nationally); forest cover ~60%; fuelwood and plantation residue
forestry_residues_odt_mt.notes: High forest cover but marginal land dominant; reforestation of karst areas; bamboo significant

msw_total_mt.source: calc: Guizhou pop 38.6 M; urbanization ~53%; per-capita MSW ~0.50 kg/d
msw_total_mt.notes: Growing rapidly; industrialization in Guiyang pulling waste generation up

msw_biogenic_frac.source: Dong et al. 2019; semi-rural higher food waste share
msw_biogenic_frac.notes: Higher biogenic fraction consistent with lower-income, more rural province

msw_treatment.source: China Statistical Yearbook on Environment 2022; SW provinces mid-tier WtE

animal_manure_odt_mt.source: calc: Guizhou cattle+pig production; national manure 840 Mt × ~1.0% share; cattle significant on karst pasture
animal_manure_odt_mt.notes: Cattle/goat grazing on karst pasture; hog production growing

human_wwtp_odt_mt.source: calc: Guizhou pop 38.6 M / 1,412 M × 13.6 Mt
human_wwtp_odt_mt.notes: WWTP expanding rapidly with urbanization; karst geology complicates sludge disposal

nutrient_status_source: Zhang et al. 2015 Nature; Guizhou phosphorus-rich soils; fertilizer use moderate
notes: Rugged karst province. Biomass widely dispersed. High forest cover provides long-term forestry option. Limited transport infrastructure increases collection cost.

name: Hainan

ag_residues_odt_mt.source: calc: NBS 2022; Hainan grain ~1.5 Mt (rice); rubber/sugarcane residue; Liu et al. 2013 RPR; limited scale
ag_residues_odt_mt.notes: Small island province; rubber tree biomass (pruning/replanting residue) more significant than grain residue

forestry_residues_odt_mt.source: Guo et al. 2023 Scientific Data; Hainan tropical plantation timber; rubber wood waste; Ulanovsky & Bhatt 2016 tropical biomass
forestry_residues_odt_mt.notes: Tropical hardwood plantations; rubber wood is significant end-of-life feedstock

msw_total_mt.source: calc: Hainan pop 10.3 M + tourist influx; per-capita MSW ~0.67 kg/d tourism-boosted; adjusted upward for seasonal tourism
msw_total_mt.notes: Tourism significantly inflates per-capita MSW relative to permanent population; Sanya/Haikou resort areas

msw_biogenic_frac.source: Dong et al. 2019; tropical diet high in fruit/vegetables; biogenic fraction elevated
msw_biogenic_frac.notes: Tropical fruit waste streams boost biogenic fraction

msw_treatment.source: China Statistical Yearbook on Environment 2022; Hainan Free Trade Port targets zero-landfill

animal_manure_odt_mt.source: calc: NBS livestock census Hainan; national manure 840 Mt × ~0.18% share
animal_manure_odt_mt.notes: Small province; pig + poultry; limited livestock relative to mainland

human_wwtp_odt_mt.source: calc: Hainan pop 10.3 M / 1,412 M × 13.6 Mt
human_wwtp_odt_mt.notes: Small population; improving WWTP under Free Trade Port development

nutrient_status_source: Zhang et al. 2015 Nature; tropical soils with high leaching; intensive banana/pineapple cultivation over-fertilized

ag_residues_odt_mt.notes: Top wheat-maize province. 75 Mt gross × 40% recoverable = 30 Mt odt. High end reflects cotton/peanut residue not captured in gross grain-residue estimate. Flat terrain facilitates high actual recovery rates.

forestry_residues_odt_mt.source: Guo et al. 2023 Scientific Data; Ma et al. 2020 identifies Shandong 11.9% national forestry residue (surprisingly high for plantation/economic forest); Chen et al. 2020; primarily economic forest (fruit/nut orchards) pruning
forestry_residues_odt_mt.notes: High rank for economic forest pruning (apple orchards Yantai, pear, chestnut); limited natural timber; orchard pruning biomass underestimated in standard forestry residue accounts

msw_total_mt.source: calc: Shandong pop 101.6 M (2nd most populous); urbanization ~63%; per-capita MSW ~0.58 kg/d; Wu et al. 2021 Frontiers Shandong top MSW provinces
msw_total_mt.notes: Second-largest population; Jinan/Qingdao/Zibo industrial cities

msw_biogenic_frac.source: Dong et al. 2019; seafood/vegetable heavy diet; moderate biogenic fraction
msw_biogenic_frac.notes: Coastal diet with higher seafood/packaging contribution

msw_treatment.source: China Statistical Yearbook on Environment 2022; Shandong major WtE capacity; Qingdao/Jinan plants

animal_manure_odt_mt.source: calc: Shandong largest hog province in per-capita terms; poultry largest nationally (Weihai/Linyi area); cattle; national manure 840 Mt × ~3.6% share; Nie et al. 2020 confirms Shandong top-5 manure
animal_manure_odt_mt.notes: Top pig and poultry province; Muyuan/New Hope Group farms based here; massive layer hen operations; Bohai Bay coastal aquaculture

human_wwtp_odt_mt.source: calc: Shandong pop 101.6 M / 1,412 M × 13.6 Mt
human_wwtp_odt_mt.notes: Large absolute sludge volume; Jinan/Qingdao advanced treatment; Bohai Sea protection mandate

nutrient_status_source: Zhang et al. 2015 Nature; Liu et al. 2010 PNAS; Shandong N application ~290 kg N/ha; vegetable greenhouses particularly over-fertilized
notes: Premier BiCRS province: top-3 ag residue, top livestock manure, large population MSW, flat terrain, existing biomass logistics infrastructure. Nutrient excess from greenhouse vegetable farming is severe.

name: Shanghai

ag_residues_odt_mt.source: calc: NBS 2022; Shanghai grain ~0.9 Mt (rice, minor vegetable); Liu et al. 2013 field residue Shanghai ~0.9 Mt air-dry; 30% recoverable
ag_residues_odt_mt.notes: Mostly urban; minor suburban rice farming in Chongming Island and Songjiang; negligible ag residue

forestry_residues_odt_mt.source: Guo et al. 2023 Scientific Data; Shanghai near-zero natural forest; urban park wood chip residue only
forestry_residues_odt_mt.notes: Urban greening and park pruning residue; no commercial forestry

msw_total_mt.source: calc: Shanghai pop 24.75 M; urbanization ~89%; per-capita MSW ~1.16 kg/d (highest in China); Shanghai mandatory sorting since 2019; CAUPD reports ~9-11 Mt managed
msw_total_mt.notes: China's highest per-capita MSW generator; mandatory 4-category sorting since July 2019; wet waste stream well-separated for composting

msw_biogenic_frac.source: Dong et al. 2019; high-income cosmopolitan city; significant packaging/non-biogenic; mandatory sorting enables better biogenic stream tracking
msw_biogenic_frac.notes: After sorting, wet (biogenic) fraction separated; remaining mixed waste lower biogenic share

msw_treatment.source: Shanghai solid waste management bulletin 2022; 3 major WtE plants (Laogang, Jiangqiao, etc.); wet waste separate composting stream
msw_treatment.notes: China's most advanced MSW management system

animal_manure_odt_mt.source: calc: Shanghai minimal livestock; national manure 840 Mt × ~0.05% share; mostly dairy/poultry in peri-urban Chongming
animal_manure_odt_mt.notes: Livestock largely excluded from city; Chongming Island ecological zone restricts farming

human_wwtp_odt_mt.source: calc: Shanghai pop 24.75 M / 1,412 M × 13.6 Mt; ~95% WWTP coverage
human_wwtp_odt_mt.notes: World-class WWTP system; sludge used for energy recovery and soil amendment; Baihe Valley sludge incineration facility operational

nutrient_status_source: Zhang et al. 2015 Nature; Shanghai peri-urban farms moderately intensive; limited agricultural footprint
notes: MSW-dominant megacity. Virtually no ag or forestry base. Best WWTP infrastructure in China. Mandatory waste sorting enables clean biogenic stream separation. WtE fleet already large.

name: Shanxi

ag_residues_odt_mt.source: calc: NBS 2022; Shanxi grain ~15 Mt (maize ~8 Mt, wheat ~4 Mt, sorghum/millet); Liu et al. 2013 RPR; 30% recoverable; Shanxi saw >400,000 t grain increase in 2022 (NBS bulletin)
ag_residues_odt_mt.notes: Loess Plateau province; maize-wheat rotation in Fen River valley; coal mining reduces viable agricultural land

forestry_residues_odt_mt.source: Guo et al. 2023 Scientific Data; Shanxi limited forest on Luliang/Zhongtiao Mountains; reforestation growing
forestry_residues_odt_mt.notes: Coal region; afforestation programs active but commercial timber minimal; mainly scrub/secondary forest

msw_total_mt.source: calc: Shanxi pop 34.8 M; urbanization ~64%; per-capita MSW ~0.51 kg/d
msw_total_mt.notes: Coal industry province; Taiyuan/Datong industrial MSW streams

msw_biogenic_frac.source: Dong et al. 2019; northern China mixed diet; moderate biogenic fraction
msw_biogenic_frac.notes: Coal dust may increase inorganic fraction; otherwise typical northern China composition

msw_treatment.source: China Statistical Yearbook on Environment 2022

animal_manure_odt_mt.source: calc: Shanxi cattle+sheep+hog; national manure 840 Mt × ~0.7% share
animal_manure_odt_mt.notes: Loess Plateau sheep grazing; Datong/Xinzhou cattle; hog production smaller

human_wwtp_odt_mt.source: calc: Shanxi pop 34.8 M / 1,412 M × 13.6 Mt
human_wwtp_odt_mt.notes: WWTP coverage improving; Yellow River protection mandate

nutrient_status_source: Zhang et al. 2015 Nature; Shanxi moderate fertilizer on limited agricultural land
notes: Coal-dominated economy. Agricultural biomass concentrated in Fen River valley. Coal infrastructure could theoretically facilitate co-processing but competing energy use. Limited BiCRS potential relative to eastern plains provinces.

name: Sichuan

ag_residues_odt_mt.source: calc: NBS 2022; Sichuan grain ~36 Mt (rice ~15 Mt, maize ~12 Mt, wheat ~7 Mt, rape); Liu et al. 2013 RPR; 30% recoverable cap (Slade et al. 2014)
ag_residues_odt_mt.notes: 4th-largest grain province (with Chongqing separated). Chengdu Plain intensively farmed. Gross field residue ~57 Mt × 40% = 23 Mt odt recoverable. Rice straw + maize stover dominant. Rugged western terrain limits actual recovery vs eastern plains.

forestry_residues_odt_mt.source: Guo et al. 2023 Scientific Data: Sichuan 82 Mt marginal land potential and significant forest residue; Chen et al. 2020 SW China forestry; bamboo forests in Meishan/Ya'an area
forestry_residues_odt_mt.notes: Diverse forest types: subtropical SW forests, alpine NW bamboo zone, Minjiang fir; bamboo processing residue significant

msw_total_mt.source: calc: Sichuan pop 83.7 M (4th largest); urbanization ~59%; per-capita MSW ~0.57 kg/d; projected 10.1 Mt in 2021 for Sichuan alone (ScienceDirect MSW projection); Chengdu metro adds ~5 Mt
msw_total_mt.notes: Chengdu megacity dominates; ScienceDirect 2021 projection of 10.1 Mt/yr for Sichuan consistent with population-based estimate

msw_biogenic_frac.source: Dong et al. 2019; spicy food culture; high food waste fraction
msw_biogenic_frac.notes: Chengdu culinary culture generates high food waste; biogenic fraction elevated

msw_treatment.source: China Statistical Yearbook on Environment 2022; Chengdu major WtE investments

animal_manure_odt_mt.source: calc: Sichuan largest hog province nationally (10.34% of national pigs per NBS); cattle 8.32% national; total national manure 840 Mt × ~4.2% share
animal_manure_odt_mt.notes: China's #1 pork province; Sichuan+Hunan+Henan = 26% national pig manure; plus beef cattle in western Sichuan; manure management critical environmental issue

human_wwtp_odt_mt.source: calc: Sichuan pop 83.7 M / 1,412 M × 13.6 Mt
human_wwtp_odt_mt.notes: Chengdu WWTP advanced; rural coverage expanding; earthquake recovery improved infrastructure

nutrient_status_source: Zhang et al. 2015 Nature; Sichuan basin intensive vegetable/rice; pig slurry over-application documented
notes: China's largest pig province and major grain producer. Chengdu Plain flat topography enables collection. Forestry resource in mountainous west. Large absolute manure stream from pig industry.

name: Tianjin

ag_residues_odt_mt.source: calc: NBS 2022; Tianjin grain ~2.4 Mt (wheat, maize); Liu et al. 2013; 30% recoverable
ag_residues_odt_mt.notes: Mostly urban municipality; peri-urban wheat-maize on Jing-Jin corridor; limited agricultural land

forestry_residues_odt_mt.source: Guo et al. 2023 Scientific Data; Tianjin near-zero natural forest; urban park residue only
forestry_residues_odt_mt.notes: Coastal port city; minimal forest resource

msw_total_mt.source: calc: Tianjin pop 13.6 M; urbanization ~85%; per-capita MSW ~1.10 kg/d (high income municipality)
msw_total_mt.notes: Industrial port megacity; petrochemical/manufacturing adds to MSW stream; Binhai New Area expansion

msw_biogenic_frac.source: Dong et al. 2019; industrial city; packaging/inorganic fraction elevated
msw_biogenic_frac.notes: Petrochemical economy increases plastic/packaging fraction

msw_treatment.source: China Statistical Yearbook on Environment 2022; Tianjin major WtE deployment consistent with Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei cluster

animal_manure_odt_mt.source: calc: Tianjin peri-urban livestock minimal; national manure 840 Mt × ~0.12% share
animal_manure_odt_mt.notes: Livestock operations largely relocated from urban core; peri-urban dairy minimal

human_wwtp_odt_mt.source: calc: Tianjin pop 13.6 M / 1,412 M × 13.6 Mt
human_wwtp_odt_mt.notes: Advanced WWTP; Haihe River restoration; high WWTP coverage

nutrient_status_source: Zhang et al. 2015 Nature; limited agricultural area; industrial nutrient loads to Bohai Bay more relevant than crop N excess
notes: Industrial port megacity. MSW-dominant. High WtE capacity. Minimal ag/forestry base. WWTP sludge is main biowaste resource alongside MSW.

name: Tibet

ag_residues_odt_mt.source: calc: NBS 2022; Tibet grain ~1.1 Mt (highland barley qingke, winter wheat at lower valleys); Liu et al. 2013; 30% recoverable; high-altitude limits
ag_residues_odt_mt.notes: Only Yarlung Tsangpo valley cultivated; highland barley dominant at 3500-4500 m altitude; very limited agricultural biomass

forestry_residues_odt_mt.source: Guo et al. 2023 Scientific Data; Tibet SE forests (Nyingchi area) subtropical/temperate; large standing biomass but legally protected; virtually no commercial harvest
forestry_residues_odt_mt.notes: Yarlung Tsangpo canyon area has some of Asia's most intact temperate forests; logging prohibited since 1994; no commercial residue available

msw_total_mt.source: calc: Tibet pop 3.64 M; per-capita MSW ~0.53 kg/d; Lhasa dominates; Tourism adds seasonal load
msw_total_mt.notes: Very small permanent population; Lhasa/Shigatse urban centers; tourism waste management improving

msw_biogenic_frac.source: Dong et al. 2019; rural/pastoral diet; high food waste fraction
msw_biogenic_frac.notes: Nomadic/pastoral diet; minimal packaging; high organic fraction

msw_treatment.source: China Statistical Yearbook on Environment 2022; limited WtE infrastructure at high altitude; Lhasa landfill dominant
msw_treatment.notes: High-altitude operations challenge WtE combustion efficiency

animal_manure_odt_mt.source: calc: Tibet large yak/sheep herds; NBS livestock census; yak ~1.5 M heads × 0.012 t DM/head/d × 365 + sheep; national manure 840 Mt × ~0.7% share
animal_manure_odt_mt.notes: Yak is primary livestock; vast nomadic herding area; manure highly dispersed across 1.2 million km²; traditionally used as fuel

human_wwtp_odt_mt.source: calc: Tibet pop 3.64 M / 1,412 M × 13.6 Mt
human_wwtp_odt_mt.notes: Very limited WWTP; permafrost and altitude complicate treatment; Lhasa modern WWTP operational

nutrient_status_source: Zhang et al. 2015 Nature; Tibetan Plateau nutrient-limited; no meaningful chemical fertilizer in nomadic areas; limited cropland
notes: Remote high-altitude province. Effectively no viable BiCRS feedstock base due to protected status, extreme remoteness, altitude, and dispersed nomadic populations. Minimal infrastructure. Yak manure locally used as fuel — not available for industrial processing.

name: Xinjiang

ag_residues_odt_mt.source: calc: NBS 2022; Xinjiang grain ~15 Mt (wheat ~7 Mt, maize ~6 Mt, cotton 0.5 Mt — cotton stalk RPR=3); cotton stalk: 0.5 Mt × 3 RPR = 1.5 Mt; Liu et al. 2013 RPR; 30% recoverable
ag_residues_odt_mt.notes: Cotton is largest industrial crop; cotton stalks significant residue; wheat/maize in Guanzhong/Tarim oases; total field residue ~35 Mt → 14 Mt recoverable

forestry_residues_odt_mt.source: Guo et al. 2023 Scientific Data; Xinjiang limited forest; Tianshan Mountains spruce forests protected; Populus/saxaul desert scrub
forestry_residues_odt_mt.notes: Semi-arid to desert; Tianshan fir/spruce protected; minimal commercial logging; poplar plantation residue in oasis zones

msw_total_mt.source: calc: Xinjiang pop 25.9 M; per-capita MSW ~0.55 kg/d; CEIC data referenced Xinjiang sheep/goats
msw_total_mt.notes: Urumqi dominates; large area but population concentrated in oases

msw_biogenic_frac.source: Dong et al. 2019; fruit-rich diet (Hami melon, dried fruits); higher biogenic fraction
msw_biogenic_frac.notes: Grape/melon/pear production; fruit processing waste elevates biogenic fraction

msw_treatment.source: China Statistical Yearbook on Environment 2022; western inland province; Urumqi WtE plant operational

animal_manure_odt_mt.source: calc: Xinjiang sheep/goat 11.10% national (2nd); cattle/camel; national manure 840 Mt × ~1.9% share; CEIC data confirms Xinjiang major sheep province
animal_manure_odt_mt.notes: Large sheep/goat population on Tianshan/Altai grasslands; ruminant manure dispersed; increasing intensive livestock in southern Xinjiang

human_wwtp_odt_mt.source: calc: Xinjiang pop 25.9 M / 1,412 M × 13.6 Mt
human_wwtp_odt_mt.notes: Urumqi WWTP modern; vast rural area without treatment

nutrient_status_source: Zhang et al. 2015 Nature; arid desert soils nutrient poor; oasis agriculture moderate fertilizer use
notes: Cotton stalk is distinctive high-volume residue not found at scale elsewhere in China. Oasis-based agriculture — feedstocks highly concentrated in narrow ribbon irrigated zones. Very long transport distances to any industrial facility.

name: Yunnan

ag_residues_odt_mt.source: calc: NBS 2022; Yunnan grain ~18 Mt (maize ~9 Mt, rice ~5 Mt, sugarcane ~18 Mt); Liu et al. 2013 RPR; sugarcane tops+leaves: 18 × 0.15 = 2.7 Mt; 30% recoverable; total field residue ~42 Mt
ag_residues_odt_mt.notes: Diverse crops: maize+rice+sugarcane+rubber; rugged terrain limits collection; tobacco residue also relevant

forestry_residues_odt_mt.source: Guo et al. 2023 Scientific Data: Yunnan 33 Mt gross forestry residue (3rd nationally); Inner Mongolia/Guangxi/Yunnan account for 28% national total; Ma et al. 2020 17.88-32.66 Mt range for top provinces
forestry_residues_odt_mt.notes: Richest biodiversity in China; subtropical/tropical forest; rubber plantation pruning; economic forest logging. 33 Mt gross → ~18 Mt recoverable odt

msw_total_mt.source: calc: Yunnan pop 46.9 M; urbanization ~50%; per-capita MSW ~0.55 kg/d
msw_total_mt.notes: Tourism (Lijiang, Dali, Xishuangbanna) inflates per-capita beyond permanent population

msw_biogenic_frac.source: Dong et al. 2019; tropical/subtropical food culture; high food waste fraction
msw_biogenic_frac.notes: Diverse ethnic food culture; tropical fruit waste; high organic fraction

msw_treatment.source: China Statistical Yearbook on Environment 2022; SW provinces mid-tier WtE; Kunming leading

animal_manure_odt_mt.source: calc: Yunnan cattle 8.69% national (largest cattle province); hog; national manure 840 Mt × ~1.9% share
animal_manure_odt_mt.notes: China's largest cattle province; extensive grazing on highland pastures; significant buffalo in Xishuangbanna

human_wwtp_odt_mt.source: calc: Yunnan pop 46.9 M / 1,412 M × 13.6 Mt
human_wwtp_odt_mt.notes: WWTP expanding; Dianchi Lake restoration driving investment; Kunming advanced treatment

nutrient_status_source: Zhang et al. 2015 Nature; Yunnan variable — Dianchi basin intensive horticulture excess; highland areas low
notes: Highest biodiversity province. Forestry and ag residue both significant. Rubber plantation residue distinct regional feedstock. Rugged terrain and ethnic minority areas complicate logistics. Dianchi Lake eutrophication drives nutrient management.

name: Zhejiang

ag_residues_odt_mt.source: calc: NBS 2022; Zhejiang grain ~8 Mt (rice ~7 Mt); tea/mulberry residue additional; Liu et al. 2013 RPR; 30% recoverable
ag_residues_odt_mt.notes: Coastal province; highly urbanized (>72%); rice-dominant with shrinking farmland

forestry_residues_odt_mt.source: Guo et al. 2023 Scientific Data; Chen et al. 2020; Zhejiang subtropical forest; bamboo (moso) major industry; bamboo processing residue significant
forestry_residues_odt_mt.notes: China's leading bamboo province; moso bamboo processing generates large residue stream; Anji/Lin'an bamboo industry cluster

msw_total_mt.source: calc: Zhejiang pop 65.8 M; urbanization ~73%; per-capita MSW ~0.63 kg/d; Wu et al. 2021 Frontiers Zhejiang in top MSW generating provinces
msw_total_mt.notes: Wealthy Yangtze Delta province; high per-capita consumption; Hangzhou/Ningbo/Wenzhou

msw_biogenic_frac.source: Dong et al. 2019; high-income coastal province; higher packaging fraction
msw_biogenic_frac.notes: E-commerce packaging; but also significant food waste from dense urban population

msw_treatment.source: China Statistical Yearbook on Environment 2022; Zhejiang national leader in WtE; Hangzhou pioneered waste sorting; multiple large plants

animal_manure_odt_mt.source: calc: Zhejiang hog+poultry; Jiaxing pig farming famous; Qiantang River watershed pig farm relocations; national manure 840 Mt × ~0.95% share
animal_manure_odt_mt.notes: Jiaxing hog farming historically dense (now reduced under lake protection); poultry in coastal areas

human_wwtp_odt_mt.source: calc: Zhejiang pop 65.8 M / 1,412 M × 13.6 Mt; high WWTP coverage >90%
human_wwtp_odt_mt.notes: Zhejiang has China's most advanced sludge-to-energy programs; Hangzhou sludge incineration

nutrient_status_source: Zhang et al. 2015 Nature; Taihu basin; intensive greenhouse vegetable production; poultry manure excess documented
notes: Wealthy coastal province. MSW dominant given high urbanization. Bamboo residue notable secondary feedstock. Among China's best WtE deployment and waste sorting systems. Taihu/Qiantang water quality issues drive biomass removal incentives.
